description: This file defines API routes for managing subtitles in a video subtitle viewer backend. It includes endpoints for listing, uploading, and retrieving subtitle files related to videos, using FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, and related services.

methods.name: list_subtitles_for_video( video_id: int = FPath(..., description="Video ID"), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_session), )
methods.description: Retrieves and returns a list of subtitles associated with a specific video ID.

methods.name: upload_subtitle_for_video( video_id: int = FPath(..., description="Video ID"), language: str = FPath(..., description="Language code (e.g. en, es, fr) in URL path is not ideal; pass as query or use form-data in future"), file: UploadFile = File(..., description="Subtitle file (.vtt or .srt)"), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_session), )
methods.description: Handles uploading a new subtitle file for a specific video and saves it to storage.

methods.name: get_subtitle_file( subtitle_id: int = FPath(..., description="Subtitle ID"), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_session), )
methods.description: Returns the raw subtitle file for a given subtitle ID.

ctags.name: FPath
ctags.pattern: /^from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, File, HTTPException, Path as FPath, UploadFile$/

ctags.name: get_subtitle_file
ctags.signature: ( subtitle_id: int = FPath(..., description="Subtitle ID"), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_session), )

ctags.name: list_subtitles_for_video
ctags.signature: ( video_id: int = FPath(..., description="Video ID"), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_session), )

ctags.name: upload_subtitle_for_video
ctags.signature: ( video_id: int = FPath(..., description="Video ID"), language: str = FPath(..., description="Language code (e.g. en, es, fr) in URL path is not ideal; pass as query or use form-data in future"), file: UploadFile = File(..., description="Subtitle file (.vtt or .srt)"), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_async_session), )
